hypothesis: Issue-specific positive yield residuals relative to comparable OFZ maturities partly converge, adding return beyond ordinary bond exposure.
relationship: new cross-sectional relative-valuation target, not V52 highest absolute yield, V53 aggregate curve governor, or V67 auction event; no old strategy rerun or V49 blend

selection.schedule: first factual TQOB decision date in each month, end of day, strictly prior snapshot only
selection.curve: leave-one-issue-out OLS of yield_at_wap_pct on [1, t-4.5, (t-4.5)^2]; t is remaining years; full rank required for every fit
selection.primary: three largest strictly positive yield residuals, tie security_id ascending
selection.control: three smallest absolute yield residuals, tie security_id ascending; not promotable
selection.paired_availability: both arms admitted only when >=8 eligible issues, all LOO fits valid, >=3 positive residuals
selection.missing_or_insufficient: no new instruction; preserve existing held risks through existing ledger, no zero-imputed observations
selection.fit_scope: current available cross-section only, never subsequent returns or full-period calibration

execution.entry: first common subsequent factual positive dirty OPEN of old and new issues
execution.cashflows: current-vintage bondization used for accounting only, explicit record-date entitlement and event-date credit, never in predictor
execution.terminal: held positions marked, not claimed liquidated; subtract one-way cost reserve on last marked holdings in reported NAV
execution.incomplete_marks: retain counts, do not fabricate rows; full-period performance null if any missing marks or unresolved cashflows/rebalances
execution.participation_capacity: unproved, must be checked at Stage3

screen_gates.pass_means: STAGE2_CANDIDATE only; no verified 20-50 percent return

limitations: A quadratic YTM cross-section is a cheap relative-value proxy, not an arbitrage-free discount curve or proof of mispricing.
Coupon, duration, liquidity and risk differences can explain residuals; close-to-curve control is not duration matched or a traded short hedge.
Bondization is current-vintage accounting evidence, not verified historical publication or actual broker cash settlement.
Fractional lots, OPEN/mark fields and percentage costs are research proxies; historical lot sizes, BBO capacity, tax and broker execution remain unproved.
Already-open 2021-2025 is development history; no unseen confirmation or live promotion.
forbidden_followups: change polynomial degree, signs, thresholds, maturity, liquidity, top count, schedule, costs or weights after outcomes
promote control or pick a good year
read protected 2026 or restart old paper bootstrap
